question: Q is the daughter of L whose only sister M is the daughter-in-law of O. The only son of O has three daughters P, R and S. How is S related to L?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) The only son of O has three daughters P, R and S. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cef9daded84464b4c497f82481e318d9178be11f6daccf68d320bdda939ea16.png] 

2) Q is the daughter of L whose only sister M is the daughter-in-law of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01eebcd5b7626c4e969f99614634dcc50386013e7d13e4160b1c5d38f619c7ef.png] 

Thus, S is L's niece or sister's daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
